en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing three women seated on the ground in an outdoor setting, each wrapped in cloth garments and headscarves. In front of them are stacked woven baskets covered with cloth, suggesting a market scene. The background is bare earth with scattered sticks and debris. The printed captions on the image read "Loanda" in the upper left and "Quitandeira de Farinha" in the upper right.
